text:
Jordan: Quick post-all-hands follow-up for reliability + RCA here: https://redwood.in/rca/206123. Asking folks to ack or volunteer for the short action list below.
Nina: Can we get a 1-line timeline for the top of the thread? execs will skim.
Sam: TL;DR timeline: 03:22 alert, 03:30 mitigation (routing fallback), 03:59 full recovery. Root cause: KV cache eviction storm on hot shards when a specific request mix hit.
Mei: Filed infra notes in the RCA re: shard placement causing hotspotting. Short-term mitigations: targeted cache bump + routing fallback. Medium-term: rebalance + eviction fix.
Ravi: I can own the KV cache pressure metric + alert. Plan: Prom exporter + alert rule, tag host_role. ETA: 10 days.
Priya: I will draft SLO burn thresholds that trigger fallback vs failover. Need Sam/Mei signals; target Wed.
Taylor: I'll own customer comms: 3-bullet note + internal support FAQ. Draft by tomorrow noon, will loop Legal if needed.
PagerBot: deploy:infra/cache-toggle 2061234700 started by Ravi  staging toggle running.
Jordan: Action items (owners & ETA):
```
- A1: Add KV cache pressure metric + alert (Ravi) - 10d
- A2: SLO thresholds & fallback spec (Priya + Sam) - 4bd
- A3: Customer comms + support FAQ (Taylor) - 1bd
- A4: Shard rebalance RFC (Mei) - next sprint
- A5: Postmortem publish + status page link (Jordan) - today EOD
```
Mei: I'll open the rebalance RFC today and include phased rollout + rollback steps.
Ravi: Acked A1. Quick Q: metric on all nodes or GPU-only? I prefer all nodes for full visibility.
Priya: All nodes please. otherwise we have blind spots.
Jordan: Thanks all  please post short updates in this thread so I can close these in the all-hands tracker. If you need help, ping @oncall and flag #eng-oncall.
Sam: One extra ask: add a small CI replay for the repro request mix (I'll prototype next week).
Taylor: Acked A3. Will post draft and tag Legal.
Jordan: Appreciate the quick ownership :raised_hands:
